_comment: Captions for the photos in src/assets/gallery/. Match 'file' to the filename exactly. A photo with no entry here still appears — it just falls back to the generic caption — and an entry whose file is missing is ignored, so the page never breaks. Order here is the order on the page.
title: Gallery
intro: Match days, training nights and the people who make up the club.

photos.caption: Celebrating a win outside the shelter
photos.alt: The Dreamers squad with arms raised and bats held up, celebrating a win in front of the ground shelter.

photos.caption: Match day at the ground
photos.alt: Players and supporters seated under the ground shelter on a match day, club flag flying beside them.

photos.caption: Player of the match
photos.alt: A Dreamers player smiling on the outfield, wearing the club's blue Player of the Match medal.

photos.caption: Training in the nets
photos.alt: Seven Dreamers players crowded together for a photo inside the practice nets after a training session.

photos.caption: Out in the middle
photos.alt: A wide view of the ground during play, fielders spread across the outfield under a blue sky.

photos.caption: Watching from the boundary
photos.alt: Players and supporters watching a match from the shelter, with the ground stretching out behind them.

photos.caption: The club cap
photos.alt: A navy Dreamers cap resting on the grass, the shield crest embroidered on the front.
